messages:
Priya: PR #8244 is ready for review (adds adaptive KV-sharding + quant-mode option) but we're blocked — RFC link not attached. Can someone from Arch take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8244 :eyes:

Lee: I can do a quick pass tomorrow morning, but I need the RFC or at least a short design summary in the PR.

Priya: sorry — should've attached. Short summary below, full RFC link coming in a minute.

Priya: Summary: add optional per-model KV-shard routing to reduce cross-GPU KV lookups for multi-tenant workloads. Backwards-compatible, default off. Requires a new shard key in request header and a deterministic placement map. SLO impact: tail latency may improve for hot prefixes; risk: imbalance if hot-keys concentrate. Canary plan: 1% traffic in us-west, monitor p50/p95 token time, queue depth, and top-10 keys distribution.

Priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8244

Priya: RFC draft: https://rdrw.dev/rfcs/kv-shard-routing-8244 (WIP)

Anya (arch): Thanks Priya. I'll read the RFC now. A couple quick asks: attach a rollback plan, define SLO delta in numbers, and add a migration note for existing routing tables. Can you paste the canary monitor queries?

Priya: sure — canary queries:
```
-- p95 token latency
SELECT percentile(0.95, token_latency_ms) FROM inference.requests WHERE route='kv-shard' AND region='us-west'
-- hot key distribution
SELECT key, count(*) FROM inference.requests WHERE route='kv-shard' GROUP BY key ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
```

Anya (arch): OK. I'll give an arch stamp after the RFC has the rollback section and migration note. If you can add those today I can sign off before EOD tomorrow.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR 8244 — all checks green :white_check_mark:

Lee: added a couple of inline comments on perf test harness (small nits)

Priya: addressed comments and pushed. RFC link updated with rollback + migration: https://rdrw.dev/rfcs/kv-shard-routing-8244#migration

Anya (arch): Reviewing final draft now. If nothing else, sending :+1: — will post formal arch-bless in PR thread shortly.

Priya: thanks! planning to schedule canary for 9am PT tomorrow if arch-bless comes through.

Anya (arch): Arch bless posted in PR. Please proceed with canary and ping me on pager if p95 increases >20%.
